data.summary: Export button does nothing on Safari

renderedFields.description: On Safari the Export button on the orders screen does nothing. No file downloads and no error appears. Chrome is fine.

comments.body:
Triaged with 🤖 using Sonnet 5:

What's happening
I could not confirm a mechanism.

Root cause
The repository holds no export code at all. There is no export endpoint and no download handler anywhere in the checkout, so the button most likely calls a route that was never built.
